verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a business phone system (for example, time-based call routing), so the axis applies. The evidence shows no recurring scheduling capability. The only date-related feature is a one-time activation date for a ported number, which is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule. Auto attendants and ring groups are routing features with no documented schedule component.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
